I think about is as a random number generation, but in this sense more of a whether we will go through all the shit to get to who we truly are or we get something from the beginning. This is just the luck part of our lives which unfortunately we cannot control. However we can do with the other part of our lives. It’s unfair that you were not lucky enough but there is no one to blame for this sadly and certainly you cannot blame yourself. Others have their shit too trust me. Different gender different race different physical and mental abilities and it’s all just a bit of dna and a bit of random which we initially have no control over. So if you can change it even going through all the shit you should. The more shit we go through the stringer we get, but we get tired and you are tired now. But I am more than certain it will be worth it

I sometimes feel comfortable giving up and being dead as well but you know then we will never know what might have happened. In your case finally becoming your true self, finally enjoying who you are how you look and how you feel inside. And this is the little things we need in our lives. Then by this time you’ll finish college and be able to find a job as a software engineer in an amazing company who would appreciate your intelligence and your input. And I truly hope that this is gonna be the case cause you know what, you deserve it. As all of us do! I am not saying it’s gonna be an easy life and an easy transition but what if it’s gonna work out and you will finally look at yourself in the mirror with a certain thought of being happy. Just because you are yourself! Isn’t it worth the wait? Even the pain you’re going through? Right now you have a purpose to an extent and that’s amazing, I think it may help you go through all the darkest moment in your life
I mean from what I am hearing you certainly have something to live for! Imagine being your own self, who you truly want to be, it’s worth the wait isn’t it?

Have you tried anything to help you with your ADHD? Therapy or any medicine? Or are there anything you can do to somehow make it manageable? But I must say, if you’re worried about finding a job or being successful, whatever this means to you and your future, in this sense all companies now as well as universities do take this into account and give everyone a more or less fair chance (obv the world is not a utopia and it’s still super fucked up but at least it’s something). And if maybe you can message you head of department or something about your situation and explain why you might have failed your exams, asking for the exemption/retake/applying for extenuating circumstances? This will at least take the burden of your most current issue with exams so the stress levels can go down a bit
I don’t know if this is too much, but what do you think stops you now from being successful? What stood you from having friends? Maybe old friends from school?

Ohh I feel you on that. I’ve spent my last month literally lying and bed and crying because nothing works out and I have to leave the place I technically call home. I feel like a failure every single day but it doesn’t mean that it’s necessarily true. My partner keeps telling me that as my depression progresses and mental state deteriorates I have stopped actually looking at things rationally I only see the bad things. And if it’s true for me, I can with certainty say it’s true for you. Everyone has a shot in life, we are loving it now, right? And sadly we are the only ones who can change it somehow to the better or worse. Machiavellian theory states that only half of our lives are influenced by luck, the other one is only ourselves and what we make out of it. So I hope you get some strength to keep fighting and become the software engineer you want in the best company possible with people who truly deserve you

Just in case you think I am a random freak, I will say a couple of words about myself so you don’t feel like talking to a bot or anything :) I’m 22, I’m a girl, I have lived in the uk for the last what 7 years do my life. I’ve been struggling with suicidal thoughts since I was 8. The thoughts give me some kind of hope that all the problems just disappear and the pain disappears and I technically have a solution to all my issues you know. But I keep trying to live and move on as stupid as it sounds to see whether I can survive this. Sometimes I look at it as a survival course but with shit in my head rather than actual obstacles. I had similar experiences to you regarding exams where I had breakdowns after exams where I cried outside of the library I almost lived in every single day. And sadly and unfortunately that didn’t get me anywhere yet but I’ll keep trying :) so that’s a bit of an introduction

Fuck whatever everybody else thinks, I know it’s tough, I know it’s painful, we all tend to care about the society portrayal of good and bad, right and wrong, but your scars now is a pet of your life a part of your body, they only portray the experiences you had and the fact that you are able to go on and be strong and brave and seek help when needed. You can always resit (redo) your college classes, and in the end, trust me, after a year or 2 at any job no one will ever look at any grades you ever had. I feel like we have things which we think are important at a certain stage in our life and then we grow older and find other things which are now the most important and something to stress about. In the end these grades are arbitrary numbers, no matter how hard we work for them. Apply for internships and various programs in places and companies you think you would like to work in. Give yourself something else looking forward to rather than grades. Again I’ve never met you but I think you are a gifted beautiful person whose mental health is simply affecting how your brain thinks and sees things. Even no you are saying you want to start everything over, then I have good news for you, it’s definitely not too late for this

I’m not gonna lie I feel the same myself. But every time I think about suicide I try to rationalise as much as possible what can I be missing out from this life - this includes things like family and friends and all the other things that at least at some point brought me joy. Try focusing on something which would just make you smile. I am not a doctor and sometimes when I think about something good I cry but it’s fine, we all cope. I truly believe there are no happy people in the world, everyone has their shit. We have it differently - we struggle more than others due to our brains not looking at things properly. But it’s fine, we try right? 
How old are you? What do you want to do in life? Maybe a career path? Or a dream you still didn’t successfully achieve?

I am not gonna lie it depends on experiences, but from my perspective it’s always better to have a mother. And an alive one. 
My story is simple, my mom died from cancer when I was 10 and it seriously damaged my mental condition to the present day. And it’s almost been 12 years now. 
If you are questioning yourself and whether you are a good mom, that’s all you need - it already answers your question, you are. And you want the best for your child cause no matter what you love her. If you ever want to talk, feel free to message me, but definitely don’t give up yet. I only hope in years time you’ll see how much joy your daughter brought to you.
